main.description: Register a creator profile on oshinobi. Caller DID becomes the creator. Age verification and payout KYC are delegated to external providers; server stores only the reference token and verification timestamp, never raw PII. Persist to vertex_oshinobi_creator (Tier 1 metadata) — displayName / bio / contentPolicy are public. payoutStatus reflects external KYC lifecycle.

ageVerificationRef.description: Opaque token from external age-verification provider (Jumio/Veriff/Yoti). Server does NOT see ID documents.

payoutProviderRef.description: Opaque reference from adult-content-capable payout processor (CCBill/Segpay/RocketGate). Server does NOT store bank details.

errors.name: AgeVerificationFailed
errors.description: ageVerificationRef rejected by provider or subject under 18

errors.name: AlreadyRegistered
errors.description: caller DID already has a creator record
